text: Core courses Elementary Accounting, Principle of Financial Management, Financial Accounting, Monetary Banking, Statistics, Securities Investment, Intermediate Financial Management, Cost Management, Assets Assessment, Management, Financial Analysis, and Management Information System Objective This objective is to train students to meet the needs of social development and market economy, and be able to be, after graduation, middle-and-high-ranking financial management personnel who grasp the theory and methods of modern enterprises’ financial management; have the relevant knowledge of accounting, management, economics, finance and law, etc; have strong professional ability, high overall qualities, be full of innovative consciousness and pioneering spirit. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management is granted.
